intro: Each platform uses product photos and short videos in different places. Browse the full list for channel-specific sizes, examples, and tips, then download the file and upload it where you sell.

faq.q: Which platform format should I make first?
faq.a: Start with the placement where you already buy traffic: 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts; 4:5 for Meta Feed images and video; square images for Amazon and Shopify product galleries.

faq.q: Can one vertical video work on TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
faq.a: Yes, a 9:16 file can fit all three. Each app places buttons and captions differently, so preview the clip in each placement before spending money behind it.

faq.q: What size should I use for a Facebook or Instagram Feed image?
faq.a: Use a 4:5 image at 1440×1800 for Meta Feed. AIVideosUGC makes square stills, so crop the downloaded image to 4:5 and check the Feed preview.

faq.q: What size should I use for a TikTok In-Feed ad?
faq.a: Use 9:16 vertical; TikTok lists 540×960 as the minimum for the recommended shape. Leave room around the product for the app controls and add final text in your editor.

faq.q: What size should I use for a YouTube Short?
faq.a: Use a 9:16 vertical file; 1080×1920 is the recommended size for a Shorts ad. Use 16:9 separately for a regular YouTube video or in-stream placement.

faq.q: What should I make for an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Start with a square plain-white main image, then add lifestyle and detail views that answer the next shopper question. Sponsored Brands video uses a separate 16:9 placement.

faq.q: What size should Shopify product images be?
faq.a: Shopify says square 2048×2048 images usually display best. Keep a consistent crop for the product gallery and make a separate 9:16 asset for social placements.

faq.q: Do you post the finished ads to my accounts?
faq.a: No. You download the video or photo and upload it yourself in Ads Manager, TikTok, YouTube, Shopify, or Amazon.

faq.q: Can I reuse one product creative on every platform?
faq.a: Reuse the product photo as a starting point, then choose the ratio for each placement. One generation uses one selected format; add captions, sound, prices, and offers after download.

faq.q: How do I keep important details out of platform controls?
faq.a: Keep the product and any later text inside the placement safe area, then preview the downloaded file in the exact Feed, Reel, Short, listing, or store slot before publishing.
